# Format 11 input-generation fixture

`format11-input-generation.sql.gz` is a compressed SQLite SQL dump generated by
the actual format-11 Core at commit `027b81ca29b6df73f9c37c2421452a1e242a6930`.
It contains synthetic, offline model/tool data only, without credentials.

The `parent` session has an observation `seen` consumed by two ordinary model
requests with a tool between them. Its later `late` and `unseen-summary-0..4`
observations were applied and compacted but never entered another generation.
A shared-history `child` forks after that compaction and runs its own prompt;
its execution must not claim the parent's observations. The `summary` session
compacts `seen-summary-0..4`, then runs a prompt that includes the summary. The
`omission` session's request preparer removes `omitted` while keeping `included`.
The `replacement` session replaces the original `replaced` observation with
unrelated same-role content. Its approximate format-11 reconstruction recipe
still references the old node, but that is not proof of generation ownership.
The `stopped` session receives `unseen-stopped` during a blocked generation,
then is cancelled. Its old queue entry has no `RunID`; the completed durable
started/terminal interval proves which stopped Run admitted it, so migration
can preserve the Host's decision to leave that observation paused.

The format-12 migration test imports this dump, confirms the old format is
rejected by normal Open, migrates offline and compares immutable history,
attempts, projections and receipts byte for byte. It also checks rebuilt frozen
requests and new input ownership after cold reopen.
